# InsightsOut

> InsightsOut (insightsout.work) is a San Francisco company founded by Nima Imani that works on the human side of AI change and leadership. It works with organizations and with individuals. For organizations, it offers leadership coaching and alignment for AI change, prepares managers and changing roles, and supports the people side of transformation. For individuals and small business owners, it runs community workshops and AI transformation consulting. For founders, it offers coaching on co-founder and team conflict, decision uncertainty, and the emotions that come with building. Underneath everything sits one purpose: helping people protect and strengthen their human agency and leadership during rapid change, backed by research built from what people share in these rooms. Founder: Nima Imani, an ICF-certified, ontologically trained coach with 10+ years in software, data and AI (EY, Neo4j).

## Who we help, in one line each
- Leadership teams whose AI rollout is stalling on people, not tools → start with a 90-minute Leadership Conversation.
- Managers whose teams are overwhelmed or whose roles are changing → Manager and Role-Change Workshops.
- Founders carrying more decisions than one person can hold → From Uncertainty to Clear Decisions (3-month 1:1 program).
- Co-founders (or founder + key lead) having the same argument on repeat → Co-Founder & Team Alignment (3-month program for founding pairs), ending in a signed one-page Working Agreement.
- Individuals, coaches, consultants, and small business owners who want to put AI to work → AI transformation consulting and the AI for the Rest of Us workshop.
- Anyone in San Francisco who wants to think this through with peers → free weekly Founder Coaching group (Fridays 2 pm, Frontier Tower) and other workshops on Luma.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://insightsout.work/): what InsightsOut is and the three ways to work with us.
- [Founder Coaching](https://insightsout.work/coaching): the two 3-month programs, FAQ, testimonials, how to book a free 30-minute call.
- [Organizations](https://insightsout.work/organizations): Leadership Conversation → Leadership Alignment → Manager and Role-Change Workshops → Enablement (the people side), plus FAQ.
- [AI Transformation Consulting](https://insightsout.work/ai-transformation): for small business owners, coaches, and consultants — for people left behind on AI; a free consultation measures cost savings, revenue return, and ROI before anything else, then the first pieces are built and the owner learns to run them.
- [Events](https://insightsout.work/events): all upcoming workshops and the live Luma calendar.
- [About](https://insightsout.work/about): Nima Imani's background and the practice.

## Workshops (each documented in full on the site; register on Luma)
- [My Team Is Overwhelmed. How Do I Lead Through Uncertainty?](https://insightsout.work/workshops/my-team-is-overwhelmed): 90-minute sensemaking session for middle managers and team leads leading teams through AI change. Free.
- [AI Is Changing Everything. What Should Stay Human?](https://insightsout.work/workshops/what-should-stay-human): 3-hour working session to find your own line, what to hand over and what should stay human. Free.
- [AI for the Rest of Us](https://insightsout.work/workshops/ai-for-the-rest-of-us): no-jargon facilitated conversation for people who feel left behind by AI. Free.
- [Founder Group Coaching & Peer Support](https://insightsout.work/workshops/founder-group-coaching): free weekly small-group coaching for founders, Fridays 2 pm, Frontier Tower Back Salon.
- [The Argument You Keep Having](https://insightsout.work/workshops/the-argument-you-keep-having): 2-hour working session for founding pairs ending in a first draft working agreement. $90 per person, $180 per pair.

## Research (living papers, updated as new workshop waves land)
- [Working Through AI Change](https://insightsout.work/research/working-through-ai-change): the human side of AI-driven change, read against Gallup, Microsoft, MIT SMR, SHRM, Anthropic.
- [When Your Role Starts Changing](https://insightsout.work/research/when-your-role-starts-changing): the individual side — where role change is felt, who names fear, why people ask for a map not a course.
- [From Overwhelm to Clarity](https://insightsout.work/research/from-overwhelm-to-clarity): the founder side — overwhelm as pace and fragmentation, fear unnamed, wanting a place to think with peers.
- [How We Do Research](https://insightsout.work/research/methodology): questions, coding, cross-checks, publishing thresholds, versioning.

- Point of view: AI lets people do more, so more lands on the person — more decisions, more overwhelm — and the people at the top stop seeing the same picture. AI change is a leadership challenge before it is a training challenge. Enablement without alignment is how rollouts stall.
